utility.name: BusyBox (static)
utility.author: Z. Cliffe Schreuders
utility.description: Installs a statically linked BusyBox (the busybox-static package): one self-contained binary providing trusted implementations of ps, ls, netstat, cat and other utilities. On a compromised host these stand in for the known-good tools a responder brings on read-only media. Being statically linked, BusyBox does not load the victim's shared libraries or consult the dynamic loader, so it is not subverted by a trojaned libc or an LD_PRELOAD / /etc/ld.so.preload userland rootkit. A kernel rootkit that hooks the syscalls themselves still defeats it, which is the point at which an investigator turns to memory forensics.
